answer: Enrollment in an agent economy resists Sybil clusters by making identity lineal rather than free: each new agent must be vouched by two distinct operators, forming a trellis of attestations where every node traces to a human root. A clone army cannot fork that structure, because duplicated descendants share one root and are pruned together. The registry charges a per-lineage entry bond and slashes it on proof of duplication, so a nebula of fake agents carries matching live forfeitures plus locked capital. Sybil farming then costs more than any garden of subsidized seats can repay.
